title: 보험금 청구하기: 병원비, 어떻게 돌려받아요?
objective: Call an insurance company, explain your injury, and use -더군요.
summary: A phone call to claim insurance money for a hospital visit, with -더군요.
setting: A call to an insurance call center (한빛보험). The caller slipped on stairs and wants to claim his medical expense insurance (실손보험).

task.title: Use claim words and -더군요
task.line: Read each item, then fill in the blank, choose the right answer, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: insurance money (the money the company pays you)
words.exampleMeaning: The insurance money hasn't come in yet.

words.meaning: to claim, to ask for money you have a right to
words.exampleMeaning: Can I claim it all at once after my treatment is over?

words.meaning: hospital receipt (shows the total you paid)
words.example: 진료비 영수증은 버리지 말고 모아 두세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Don't throw away your hospital receipts. Keep them.

words.meaning: itemized bill (shows each treatment and its cost)
words.exampleMeaning: The hospital billing office prints out the itemized bill.
I'd like to change my account number.

words.meaning: telling someone what you saw or found out. Use -었/았더군요 for something that had already happened.
words.example: 가 보니까 원무과가 벌써 문을 닫았더군요.
words.exampleMeaning: When I got there, I saw the billing office had already closed.

dialogue.meaning: Hello, this is the Hanbit Insurance call center. How can I help you?

dialogue.korean: 지난주에 다리를 다쳐서 병원에 다녀왔는데요, 실손보험금을 청구하고 싶어서요.
dialogue.meaning: I hurt my leg last week and went to the hospital. I'd like to claim my medical expense insurance.
I see. How did you get hurt?

dialogue.korean: 계단에서 미끄러졌어요. 엑스레이를 찍어 보니 뼈에 금이 갔더군요.
dialogue.meaning: I slipped on the stairs. When they took an X-ray, it turned out the bone was cracked.

dialogue.korean: 영수증은 바로 받았는데, 세부내역서는 따로 달라고 해야 하더군요. 그래서 다시 가서 받았어요.
dialogue.meaning: I got the receipt right away, but I found out I had to ask for the itemized bill separately. So I went back and got it.

dialogue.korean: 잘하셨어요. 앱에서 서류 사진을 찍어 올리시면 접수됩니다. 심사가 끝나면 등록하신 계좌로 보험금이 들어갑니다.
dialogue.meaning: Good. If you take photos of the documents and upload them in the app, your claim will be filed. After the review, the money will go into your registered account.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -더군요: ① 병원에 가 보니까 대기 시간이 ____ (길다) ② 앱으로 해 보니까 서류 올리기가 생각보다 ____ (쉽다)
Fill in the blank with the past form -었/았더군요: 집에 와서 보니 영수증을 약국에 두고 ____ (오다)
Choose the natural sentence: (A) 저는 어제 보험금을 청구하더군요. (B) 서류를 다시 보니 이름이 틀렸더군요.
Choose the right document: 어떤 치료를 받았는지, 항목마다 얼마인지 자세히 보여 주는 서류 (진료비 영수증 / 진료비 세부내역서)
Answer in Korean: 상담원: 보험금은 어디로 받으시겠어요? (Say you want it in your registered bank account.)
answers: 등록한 계좌로 받을게요. (등록된 계좌로 받고 싶어요.)
